title: When the Inventory Sings
author: Edmund Winterbourne
blurb: Orsen Nystrom, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
